topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Rain or no rain, shouldn't be parkin' where they don't want ya. Found out the hard way when I stepped outta my pad and my ride was gone. Took a minute, just standing there, watching the rain soak through the cheap paint on the mailbox. Nothing good in this world ever stays put, I guess. Called around, and they said it was towed, like a dog dragged off by the collar. Cost me, and it ain't just the money either. You start thinkin' about all the choices that led up to that empty spot on the driveway. Next time, I'll park smarter. Or maybe I'll just walk.
